name: flatnotes
description: Simple note app that keeps your notes as plain Markdown files

paths.name: Data
paths.description: Your notes as Markdown files, attachments, the search index and this install's password and secret key.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: flatnotes web app, published on host as 6871

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: The user id that owns the app's files. 500 is the MOS default.

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: The group id that owns the app's files. 500 is the MOS default.

variables.name: FLATNOTES_USERNAME
variables.description: The user name you sign in with. The password is shown in the app's logs, in the box marked CREDENTIALS.
